message.content: Hey, I’m drowning in my final year studio project. I need to send a quick email to Professor Kim to ask if we can extend the model submission by two days. He’s been super strict lately.

content.text:
I can help with that. Since you're asking for an extension, it's best to be polite and give a brief reason without over-explaining. Here’s a draft:

Subject: Request for Extension - Final Studio Model Submission

Dear Professor Kim,

I hope you are having a good week. I am writing to respectfully request a two-day extension for the final model submission. I want to ensure the details meet the required standards before turning it in. Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
Ji-woo Park

message.content: That looks good. Send it? Also, can you add my student ID to the signature just in case?

content.text: Sure, I've added your student ID. I’ll send it now. While that goes through, do you want me to look up the grocery list for your dinner tonight? You mentioned wanting to cook something simple since you have studio all day tomorrow.

message.content: Yes, please. I want to make pasta. Check if we have olive oil and garlic. Oh, and remind me about the laundry. I need to wash my studio clothes.

content.text: I’ve checked your inventory. You have olive oil and garlic. For the laundry, I’ve set a reminder for you to use EcoClean Liquid when you do the wash tonight. It’s your usual brand, right?

message.content: Yeah, that’s the one. Okay, add pasta, tomatoes, and basil to the shopping list. And check if I need to buy any more of the detergent.

content.text: I’ve added pasta, tomatoes, and basil to your shopping list. Regarding the detergent, you have enough EcoClean Liquid for about two more loads. You don’t need to buy more right now.

message.content: Good. I’ll just focus on the model tomorrow. Thanks for handling the email and the list.

content.text: You're welcome. The email is sent, and the shopping list is saved to your phone. Good luck with the studio work!
